question: Whether temperature scaling is sufficient for calibrating diverse model types (e.g., decision trees, k-NN) in the ensemble.
description: The idea assumes standard calibration methods work for all model types, but some methods like temperature scaling are designed for neural networks. Other models may require different calibration techniques.
rationale: If calibration fails for certain model types, the unified reliability metric may not be achievable, undermining the approach.
resolution: Temperature scaling has been shown to improve calibration for tree-ensemble classifiers (e.g., skin lesion work), suggesting it may work for some non-neural network models, but evidence for other types like k-NN is lacking.
